title: delphinium consolida subsp. divaricatum
intro: Delphinium consolida subsp. divaricatum, commonly known as Larkspur, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Larkspur include analgesic, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Larkspur include delphinine, methyllycaconitine, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
